title: Rundeck: In Eclipse Jetty, across various versions of `jetty-annotations`, and `jetty-eeN-annotations`, the Jakarta…
description: A high-severity security vulnerability (CVE-2026-18661) affects the Rundeck package due to issues in Eclipse Jetty's handling of Jakarta Servlet security annotations across various versions of jetty-annotations and jetty-eeN-annotations. The flaw involves the authoritative URL pattern rules for mixed @ServletSecurity annotations and web.xml configurations. This vulnerability is fixed in Rundeck version 6.0.1-r11.
